title: Learning Manifold and It\^o Dynamics with Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2606.05272v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) stay accurate under irregular sampling while taking far fewer integration steps than standard neural differential equations, summarising a finely sampled driver by its log-signature and advancing the hidden state over coarse intervals using the log-ODE method. This efficiency rests on the shuffle algebra, the algebraic counterpart of Stratonovich calculus. This reliance means NRDEs cannot expose the quadratic-variation terms It\^o dynamics require, nor the ordered covariant derivatives that govern It\^o flows on connection-equipped manifolds. Ameliorating this, we introduce Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations (B-NRDEs), a Hopf-algebraic framework that recasts the NRDE log-ODE step as geometric numerical integration on the state-space manifold, matching the driving algebra to the governing calculus: Grossman--Larson rooted trees for Euclidean It\^o dynamics, the Munthe--Kaas--Wright

translated_title: 基于分支神经粗糙微分方程学习流形与伊藤动力学
translated_abstract: 神经粗糙微分方程在不规则采样下仍能保持准确性，同时比标准神经微分方程所需的积分步数少得多，其方法是通过对数签名总结精细采样的驱动信号，并使用对数ODE方法在粗时间区间上推进隐状态。这种效率建立在洗牌代数之上，即Stratonovich微积分的代数对应物。然而这种依赖意味着NRDE无法表达伊藤动力学所需的二次变差项，也无法处理配备联络的流形上支配伊藤流的有序协变导数。为改善这一状况，我们提出了分支神经粗糙微分方程，这是一个Hopf代数框架，将NRDE的对数ODE步骤重新表述为状态空间流形上的几何数值积分，使驱动代数与支配微积分相匹配：对欧氏空间中的伊藤动力学使用Grossman–Larson有根树，对Munthe–Kaas–Wright
tldr: 提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDE），利用Hopf代数框架将NRDE的对数ODE步骤重构为状态空间流形上的几何数值积分，使驱动代数与伊藤微积分相匹配，从而能够处理伊藤动力学所需的二次变差项及流形上的有序协变导数。
en_tdlr: We introduce Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations (B-NRDEs), a Hopf-algebraic framework that recasts the NRDE log-ODE step as geometric numerical integration on the state-space manifold, matching the driving algebra to the governing calculus to expose the quadratic-variation terms of Itô dynamics and the ordered covariant derivatives of Itô flows on manifolds.
